`root` sets `font-size: 16px` and `line-height: 2` (unitless), so the effective line-height is `2 × font-size`. Since `root>big` overrides `font-size` to `32px` and doesn’t change `line-height`, the line-height becomes `2 × 32px = 64px`. This matches the provided `getBoundingClientRect()` for `root>big` (`height=64`).  
ANSWER: 64
